description: NaMg₆WO₈ is alpha Po-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.32 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.04 Å) and four longer (2.17 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.15 Å) and four longer (2.17 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.23 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.20 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one W atom to form OMg₅W octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₅W octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent W atoms to form ONa₂Mg₂W₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂W₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂W₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent W atoms to form ONa₂Mg₂W₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂W₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.23 Å. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂W₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.12 Å.
